SELECT mi.*, mu.username AS account_username, mu.status AS account_status FROM merchant_info mi LEFT JOIN merchant_user mu ON mi.user_id = mu.id AND mu.del_flag = '0' WHERE mi.del_flag = '0'
AND mi.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND mi.status = #{status}
ORDER BY mi.create_time DESC
